kind: 原创 AI 生成童话场景插画
prompt:
Original children's picture-book illustration for an interactive storybook Chinese food game, wide horizontal 16:10 canvas. Show a beautifully handcrafted, romantic, sunlit fairy-tale CASTLE KITCHEN interior from directly in front, straight-on symmetrical surfaces, eye-level view (flat elevation), no words or letters. Creamy pale butter and pink plaster stone with lake-blue trim, old oak furnishings, delicate climbing roses, breakfast china, a brass pot, a few cookbooks, carved peach stone arcades, a little castle turret decorative corbel. Airy, painterly soft wax crayons and colored pencil with fine warm brown contour on textured matte paper. Strong, appealing authored art direction; detailed but not cluttered. Two critically important interactive areas:
1. The upper left-center wall has ONE VERY LARGE single arched VIEW WINDOW with a wide carved butter-colored stone frame, taking about 38% of the picture width and 54% of height. Position of the actual clean window opening approx x=19%-55%, y=12%-62%. Interior shape: perfectly simple vertical left/right sides and a semicircle top, a flat bottom. Every part of that clear opening must be completely visible, unoccluded. Fill its WHOLE interior with ONLY an even flat uniform solid sky-blue wash, absolutely NO scenic elements inside, no sky details or gradients, no spots, no clouds, no substantial paper texture, NO windowpanes/mullions, casements or rails. No curtains, vines, props, food, cat, reflections or anything extending within the outside shape formed by the frame. We'll add scenery behind it outside the image. Ample clear horizontal stone sill below the opening.
2. At the far right, a separate charming arched hearth framed in warm dusty-rose and tan sandstone, about 22% of the width, soot-dark aubergine hearth cavity clearly visible behind a small neat pile of brown logs near the firebox floor at x=84%, y=73%. Totally UNLIT, no flame, no sparks, no embers, no lamp in the hearth. The dark firebox must be fully visible and in particular not obscured by foreground props.
In the center foreground, between the window and hearth and below the sill, an ORIGINAL adorable chubby orange tabby chef with a blue gingham kerchief on its head, joyful little face, holding a small golden omelette rice plate behind a low wooden prep counter; a tiny fluffy butter-yellow duckling assistant near its feet. Cat must not overlap the glass opening at all; place whole figure right of the window around x64% and in front of stone wall, keep hearth unobstructed. Low table across bottom has bowls, checked pastel napkin, an open illustrated recipe book without text. Create a cozy romantic castle, rosy brick wall fluted arches and a pastel blue alcove shelf at far left; use a little sprig of jasmine to decorate the stone surround outside the window. Maintain visual breathing room. Entire scene within frame, crisp clearly delineated opening edges, all four edges visible. No more windows. No text, logos, watermarks, magical hat, crystal ball, characters from existing franchises, or UI.
geometryMethod: 从原画蓝色连通域提取窗洞边界，简化误差 0.85 个归一化视盒单位；另行目检遮罩与壁炉位置。
